title: Stabilize toolchain and build

context.summary: Install and lock workspace dependencies, then make the existing monorepo compile under the strict TypeScript settings.
context.background: TASK-15 left runtime wiring structurally validated without installed dependencies. TASK-16 turns the structural workspace into an executable TypeScript workspace before the remaining runtime MVP tasks.

in: Install pnpm workspace dependencies and commit pnpm-lock.yaml.
Run the root typecheck with the real TypeScript compiler.
Fix strict TypeScript errors without weakening tsconfig strictness.
Keep existing scaffold behavior and explicit future-task placeholders intact.
Update task metadata and relevant development documentation if the toolchain workflow changes.
out: Implement auth token verification or route authorization.
Implement worker processing, jobs API or vector search.
Replace Docker Compose placeholder app services.
Add production runtime behavior for MCP stdio, CLI acceptance or Hermes SDK integration.

acceptance_criteria: pnpm-lock.yaml exists and resolves the current workspace dependencies.
Root pnpm typecheck runs the local TypeScript compiler and passes.
Root pnpm test passes with the current scaffold test contract.
Task validation passes and TASK-16 is registered as the current task.
No product runtime behavior from TASK-17 or later is implemented.

manual_checks: Confirm strict TypeScript settings remain enabled.
Confirm future runtime placeholders for auth, upload runtime, jobs, workers, vector search, MCP stdio and Hermes remain out of scope.

risks: Dependency versions are newly locked, so later tasks should avoid broad dependency churn.
The current test script is still a scaffold placeholder and does not prove runtime behavior.
The workspace compiles, but live PostgreSQL, Redis, API, worker and MCP runtime checks remain future tasks.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
